## Current language/theme handoff — 2026-09-08

English-default, Korean/Japanese switching, dark mode, and Web-HQ return navigation are implemented. All 51 pages, localized downloads, browser checks, numerical references, notebook reproduction, and the 118-file package passed their checks. See [current validation and review scope](localization.md). All Markdown documentation is now maintained in English, including source files and Korean/Japanese edition copies. Website and download localization remains available. The remaining sections preserve historical work records.
